mods.name: The Dead Man's Switch - Joint Operations

limitations: MI device/blood tests verify resource selection and native Job construction, not every complete procedure.
DMS responder check was called at 1200 ticks while TendPatient was still active; the same job passed after another 2400 ticks.
Tinker remains uncontrolled in the fixture because its bandwidth cost is 6 and Lady/Maiden already use 4 of 6. Native Tinker/FFF concurrent repair JobDriver execution remains untested.
MobileDragoon, AncientCorps, Motorized were loaded and audited; their individual specialized flows were not all executed.
Full robotic surgery, deactivated-body control/resurrection, and all third-party addon combinations remain untested.
